additional_info.subject: ID0461528-DC/Si-D/TR-[MULTIPLE]Request for IMEI Numbers of Routers CRM:00472000442
additional_info.body:
Dear Emre,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0461528
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Multiple
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Low
Possible solution: We've reviewed your query, and we wanted to provide some clarity on this particular task.
While we understand the importance of this information, we'd like to kindly inform you that checking router IMEIs is not an activity that falls within the standard scope of our Service team's planned responsibilities.
Additionally, our team is currently operating with limited capacity, and we are prioritizing our core service activities to ensure we can provide timely and effective responses to all tickets that fall within our defined scope.
However, we've identified an alternative solution that might be more efficient for you. As you have SSH access to the chargers, you are fully equipped to consult this IMEI information directly.
Would it be possible for you to perform this check yourself using your existing SSH access? This would allow for a quicker resolution on your end and help us manage our current workload effectively, ensuring we can continue to focus on our primary service functions.
We truly appreciate your understanding and cooperation on this matter.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-TR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
